'''Suraya''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal who ran the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] operating in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Suraya once upset [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] by praising one of his lieutenants who had, unbeknownst to Suraya, been fed to the [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]]. Fearing for his life, Suraya fled [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], ending up on Tasariq.<ref name="J15" />

Suraya arrived on the same day [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Dem Keval]] announced new tariffs on off-world goods. The smuggler had money and contacts, and established himself as the foremost black market operator on the planet. Suraya paid protection money to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kullan Velerinden]] and kept a low profile, buying a [[K4 security droid]] named [[K4X4]] to protect him from Jabba's reprisals. In truth, Jabba had long forgotten about Suraya.<ref name="J15" />
